subject: Stowe kitchen - install timing and hardware
snippet: Ben, we're getting excited. Are we still good for the December install...
body:
Ben,

We're getting excited about the kitchen. Are we still on track for the December install? Linda also wanted to confirm the corner cabinet will be the lazy Susan we talked about.

Thanks,
Scott

subject: Re: Stowe kitchen - install timing and hardware
snippet: Cabinets are on track. Install begins Dec 7, multi-day...
body:
Scott,

Cabinets are on track. Install begins December 7, should run a few days. Corner cabinet is the lazy Susan, confirmed.

I'm pricing the Blum hardware now and will confirm the lead time before I order anything.

Ben

subject: Re: Stowe kitchen - install timing and hardware
snippet: Perfect. We'll have the room cleared out by the 5th.
body: Perfect. We'll have the room cleared out by the 5th. Appreciate it, Ben.\n\nScott

subject: Bookshelf install Friday the 16th
snippet: Hi Ben, just confirming you're still planning to install the built-ins...
body:
Hi Ben,

Just confirming you're still planning to install the built-ins this Friday the 16th. I'll be home all morning. Anything you need from me beforehand?

Thanks,
Alan

subject: Re: Bookshelf install Friday the 16th
snippet: Yes - shelves are finished and staged. I'll be there 8 AM...
body:
Alan,

Yes. Shelves are finished and staged in the shop. I'll be there around 8 AM with the truck. Just need the wall clear and a parking spot for the F-350.

Should be done by early afternoon.

Ben

subject: Re: Bookshelf install Friday the 16th
snippet: Sounds good. Driveway will be open. See you Friday.
body: Sounds good. Driveway will be open for the truck. See you Friday.\n\nAlan

subject: Your cherry order is in
snippet: Ben - the 4/4 select cherry you ordered came in this morning...
body:
Ben,

The 4/4 select cherry you ordered came in this morning. 120 board feet, looks clean. Hold it on the rack for you?

Ray

subject: Re: Your cherry order is in
snippet: Thanks Ray. I'll swing by Thursday with the truck.
body: Thanks Ray. I'll swing by Thursday with the truck to pick it up. Hold it on the rack.\n\nBen

subject: Sloan invoice + dinner Friday
snippet: I flagged the Sloan table invoice in QuickBooks. Parker Pie Friday?
body: Flagged the Sloan table invoice in QuickBooks - it's paid, marking it closed. Parker Pie Friday night? I'll call ahead.\n\nD

subject: Re: Sloan invoice + dinner Friday
snippet: Yep. Pizza Friday. I'll drive.
body: Yep. Pizza Friday. I'll drive.\n\nB

subject: Coming up the 25th
snippet: Hi Dad - Tom and I are planning to come up Saturday the 25th...
body:
Hi Dad,

Tom and I are planning to come up Saturday the 25th. Mom said she'd do a roast. Can we take Birch and Sawdust for a walk up Wylie Hill? Miss you both.

Love, Marie

subject: Re: Coming up the 25th
snippet: Good. The dogs will be glad. Drive safe.
body: Good. The dogs will be glad of it. We'll be here. Drive safe.\n\nDad

subject: Re: Coming up the 25th
snippet: See you then!
body: See you then! We'll bring cider from the Montpelier farmers market.\n\nMarie

subject: Added the Sloan table photos to the site
snippet: Dad - put the cherry table photos up on the gallery page. Looks sharp.
body:
Dad,

Put the cherry table photos up on the gallery page on coxcustomwoodwork.com. Looks sharp. Two new inquiries came through the contact form this week - forwarded them to your Gmail.

Keith

subject: Re: Added the Sloan table photos to the site
snippet: Thanks. Saw the inquiries. One looks like a real job.
body: Thanks. Saw the inquiries. The Morrisville one looks like a real job - a bank of built-ins. I'll call her this week.\n\nDad

subject: Referral - kitchen island
snippet: Mr. Cox, you built our dining table. We'd love an island to match...
body:
Mr. Cox,

You built our cherry dining table last spring - we couldn't be happier. We're now thinking about a kitchen island to match. Would you have time this winter to talk?

Donna Sloan

subject: Re: Referral - kitchen island
snippet: Glad the table's holding up. I can look after the holidays.
body:
Donna,

Glad the table's holding up. My winter is full with the Stowe kitchen, but I can come measure after the holidays. I'll call to set a time.

Ben Cox
Cox Custom Woodwork
